item.title: Women & Infants appoints Mass. executive as new president
item.description: PROVIDENCE – Erin Yale, chief operating officer of Beth Israel Deaconess Hospital-Plymouth in Massachusetts, has been named president and chief operating officer of Women & Infants Hospital. item.title: R.I., Mass. gas prices jump more than 40 cents a gallon
